title: Report Location scope follows the signed-in user's enrollments
custom_preconds:
The signed-in admin has access to at least two locations (the report Location filter is not rendered for a single-location user).

One further location exists that the signed-in admin does NOT have access to, with at least one department available at it (seeded).

The Work In Progress remembered view is cleared, so the report opens on the user's currently active location (the documented default when no view is remembered).

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Administration > Staff and locate your own staff row, then click its Departments button
custom_steps_separated.expected: The "Manage staff enrollments" dialog opens and lists the locations you currently have access to.

custom_steps_separated.content: Select the location you do not yet have access to, select a department, and click Enroll
custom_steps_separated.expected: The new location/department pair is added to the Current enrollments list, granting you access to that location.

custom_steps_separated.content: Navigate to Reports > Work In Progress (a browser reload is fine)
custom_steps_separated.expected: The report renders and its Location filter is visible.
The location you were given access to is offered as an option — the filter lists the locations the signed-in user can access.

custom_steps_separated.content: Navigate back to Administration > Staff, reopen your own enrollments dialog, and remove the access added earlier
custom_steps_separated.expected: That row disappears from the Current enrollments list, removing your access to that location.

custom_steps_separated.content: Navigate back to Work In Progress and open the Location filter panel
custom_steps_separated.expected: The location you no longer have access to is not offered, and the filter's scope read-out names no removed location. --- This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582 and the Work In Progress Report specification (Confluence page 703660034), Story 7 requirements S7-R9 and S7-R11 — the Location filter lists the locations the signed-in user can access, and the default when no view is remembered is the user's currently active location, read on 10 September 2026. Hiding the filter for a single-location user is per the Parts Velocity Report specification (page 620888066, S2-E4) and the product owner's answer of 5 August 2026.
